Benchmark pages (plan 10.4)

Micro benchmarks: click, 50 requests.

Agent tasks (bench/agent/tasks): each page posts what the user did to /bench/record, which the verifier reads (what it has).

  • login, signup (three steps), shipping (validation)
  • upload, downloads, keyboard shortcut
  • popup, dialogs, cross-site iframe, shadow DOM
  • drag to reorder, hover menu, pagination, table
  • slow result, localStorage flag, mobile layout bug
  • console error, failed request
